tests.title: Control-plane store bootstraps from advertised public relays, waits for EOSE, then subscribes live
tests.description: Proves the browser bootstrap path uses `Nostr discovery events` relay discovery, queries canonical Bahia-authored read models through historical catch-up, and stays in live subscription mode afterward.
preconditions: Mock `Nostr discovery events` advertises `features.relay_read_models=true`, at least one browser relay, and the Bahia service pubkey.
Mock Nostr client exposes deterministic `queryUntilEose` and `subscribe` behavior.
steps: Call `bootstrapControlplane()`.
Assert relay discovery, connect, `queryUntilEose`, and `subscribe` are called with Bahia-authored read-model filters.
Assert the store transitions to `ready=true`, `bootstrapComplete=true`, and `status='live'`.
tests.expected_result: Shared control-plane state is populated from public relay read models and live subscriptions remain active after catch-up.
data_requirements: Canonical Bahia service pubkey
At least one service, environment, and state event authored by that pubkey
determinism_notes: Relay responses are fully mocked; no live relay is used.
Historical catch-up is driven by deterministic fixture events rather than timers or sleeps.

tests.title: Bootstrap fails closed when relay-read-model prerequisites are missing
tests.description: Covers the negative bootstrap branches where relay read models are not advertised or no browser relays are exposed by `Nostr discovery events`.
preconditions: Mock `Nostr discovery events` can be varied per test case.
steps: Call `bootstrapControlplane()` with `relay_read_models=false`.
Call `bootstrapControlplane()` with no browser relay list.
Assert the store reports an error and does not attempt relay connection in either case.
tests.expected_result: The browser does not silently fall back to non-canonical bootstrap behavior when public relay prerequisites are absent.
data_requirements: One Nostr discovery payload with `relay_read_models=false`
One Nostr discovery payload with missing `nostr.browser_relays`
determinism_notes: Both branches are local unit cases with no network dependencies.

tests.title: Service create helper publishes kind 5964 and awaits correlated 7963/7961 results
tests.description: Verifies helper-level signer-first request shaping for service creation without REST CRUD dependence.
preconditions: Public command helper module is loaded with mocked request publication and result-await helpers.
steps: Call `createService(payload)`.
Assert `publishRequest` receives kind `5964` with the payload.
Assert `awaitResult` is called with the correlated request id and service result kinds.
tests.expected_result: Service creation uses the signer-first public command/result contract at the helper layer.
data_requirements: Valid service create payload including name, artifact repo, runtime type, and default branch
determinism_notes: The request event id and result event are stubbed and deterministic.

tests.title: Browser smoke journey uses signer-first public request kinds and excludes encrypted 5980
tests.description: Exercises the browser route and records the emitted request kinds across create, preview, deploy-intent, and approval operations.
preconditions: The public service/deployment browser harness is installed.
Public Nostr discovery advertises relay-read-model support and a canonical service pubkey.
steps: Create a service from `/services`.
Create a deployment intent from `/services/[id]`.
Approve the pending deployment from `/deployments/pending`.
Read the recorded published request kinds from the E2E trace.
tests.expected_result: The flow uses public request kinds `5964`, `5989`, `5961`, and `5966`, and the captured trace does not contain encrypted request kind `5980`.
data_requirements: One existing service, artifact, and environment in the public harness state
determinism_notes: The harness records published kinds in browser-local state; no live relay or REST service is required.
The assertion is based on captured request trace, not time-based observation.

tests.title: Successful service creation immediately renders the new service on `/services` in the default list state
tests.description: Proves immediate service-list hydration from the successful create-result path by suppressing the synthetic live create projection.
preconditions: The public browser harness is installed with `emitCreateServiceProjection=false`.
`/services` starts in the default unfiltered, first-page state.
steps: Open `/services`.
Submit the create-service modal with a valid new service.
Assert the modal closes and the new service row appears without manual refresh or navigation away.
tests.expected_result: The created service is visible immediately in the same browser session even when the relay projection is intentionally withheld.
data_requirements: Initial state with exactly one visible service
New service payload with distinct name and artifact repo
determinism_notes: The harness suppresses the synthetic projection so visibility depends on the route's result-handling code path.
This test covers only the default list context, not active filters or non-first pages.

tests.title: Immediate visibility behavior under active search, runtime filter, or non-first-page state is explicitly verified
tests.description: Browser coverage now proves `/services` preserves active search/filter/pagination state after create and only auto-shows the created service when it already matches the active view.
preconditions: The public browser harness is installed with `emitCreateServiceProjection=false`.
The test case explicitly configures search, runtime-filter, or pagination state before creating the service.
steps: Open `/services` with a non-default search, runtime filter, or page selection active.
Create a new service that may or may not match the current view.

Assert the page behaves exactly as approved by HitL: either reset state to show the new row, preserve state with alternate affordance, or only auto-show when the new service already matches the current view.
tests.expected_result: Immediate post-create visibility behavior under non-default list state is proved against an explicit product decision rather than implied by the default-view smoke test.
fixtures: Expanded `createPublicState()` fixture with multiple services and mixed runtime types
data_requirements: At least one page boundary or search mismatch scenario
A newly created service whose visibility outcome differs depending on the approved UX rule
determinism_notes: The suppressed-projection harness keeps the assertion focused on immediate create-result hydration rather than later relay projection arrival.
The test now deterministically covers preserved search, runtime-filter, and pagination behavior without live services or timing sleeps.

tests.title: Policy preview helper publishes kind 5989 and returns parsed evaluation payload
tests.description: Verifies helper-level signer-first request shaping for deployment policy preview and parsed result handling.
preconditions: Public command helper module is loaded with mocked request publication and result-await helpers.
steps: Call `evaluatePolicy({ artifact_id, environment_id })`.
Assert `publishRequest` receives kind `5989` with `artifact` and `environment` tags.
Assert the parsed preview payload is returned to the caller.
tests.expected_result: Policy preview uses the signer-first public request/result contract instead of a REST evaluation endpoint.
data_requirements: Artifact id and environment id
Mocked `7962` preview result payload with `allowed`, `warnings`, `blockers`, and `results`
determinism_notes: The preview result event is stubbed directly and parsed synchronously by the helper.

tests.title: Browser deploy flow requests policy preview before attempting deployment intent creation
tests.description: Confirms the browser deploy modal triggers the signer-first preview path as part of the real route interaction.
preconditions: The public browser harness is installed in preview-allow mode.
steps: Open `/services/[id]` and launch the deploy modal.
Select an environment and artifact.
Inspect the recorded request kinds after the modal flow runs.
tests.expected_result: The request trace contains kind `5989` as part of the deploy-modal journey.
data_requirements: One deployable service with at least one artifact and one environment
determinism_notes: The trace is captured from the harness request log, so the assertion does not depend on network timing.

tests.title: Deployment intent creation stays blocked when policy preview fails
tests.description: Covers the route-level failure branch where preview returns an error and the modal must refuse to publish the deploy-intent request.
preconditions: The public browser harness is installed with `policyPreviewMode='error'`.
steps: Open the deploy modal for an existing service.
Select environment and artifact to trigger preview.
Assert blocking feedback is shown and the Create Intent button stays disabled.
Force form submission and verify no kind `5961` request is recorded.
tests.expected_result: Preview failure keeps intent creation blocked and only the preview request kind is emitted.
data_requirements: Deterministic preview error string such as `preview backend offline`
determinism_notes: The harness returns the preview error immediately; no asynchronous wait loop is required.

tests.title: Deployment intent creation stays blocked when policy preview reports blockers
tests.description: Covers the route-level blocker branch where preview succeeds structurally but returns blocking policy violations.
preconditions: The public browser harness is installed with `policyPreviewMode='block'`.
steps: Open the deploy modal for an existing service.
Select environment and artifact to trigger preview.
Assert blocking policy text is shown and the Create Intent button stays disabled.
Force form submission and verify no kind `5961` request is recorded.
tests.expected_result: Preview blockers prevent deployment-intent publication and present blocking feedback to the user.
data_requirements: Deterministic blocker payload containing at least one failed `block` policy result
determinism_notes: The harness returns a fixed blocked preview payload and captures request kinds locally.

tests.title: Deployment intent creation remains blocked while policy preview is still in flight
tests.description: Browser coverage now proves the explicit preview-loading branch keeps deployment intent creation disabled and unpublished until a delayed successful preview resolves.
preconditions: The public browser harness exposes delayed preview resolution for one or more pending preview requests.
The deploy modal is opened for a service with selectable environment and artifact values.
steps: Trigger policy preview and hold the preview request open.
Assert the Create Intent button is disabled and the route shows loading-state gate text.
Attempt form submission while preview is unresolved and verify no kind `5961` request is published.
Resolve the preview and verify the gate only clears after a successful no-blocker result.
tests.expected_result: The deploy modal stays blocked during the in-flight preview period and does not emit a deployment-intent request early.
data_requirements: A preview response that can be manually resolved after UI assertions are made
determinism_notes: The test holds preview requests open and resolves them under browser-test control instead of using sleeps.
Coverage now includes both the basic loading-state gate and a stale delayed-preview response being ignored after a newer request supersedes it.

tests.title: Direct canonical 5961 requests are rejected when policy evaluation would block deployment intent creation
tests.description: Backend contract coverage now proves canonical kind `5961` deployment-intent requests are rejected before intent creation when policy evaluation blocks the artifact/environment pair.
preconditions: A human decision exists on whether backend `5961` handling must enforce policy evaluation.
A test reactor can be constructed with deterministic service, environment, artifact, registry, and policy-service collaborators.
steps: Publish or inject a canonical kind `5961` request event that references a policy-blocked artifact/environment pair.
Observe the backend result without going through the web modal.
Assert the backend rejects the request and does not create a deployment intent if the authoritative contract requires policy enforcement.
tests.expected_result: The canonical deployment-intent request surface either enforces policy gating for all authorized clients or is explicitly documented and tested as a UI-only preflight, per HitL decision.
fixtures: Deterministic policy evaluation stub returning `allowed=false` with blockers
data_requirements: Valid service id, environment id, and artifact id
A blocked policy evaluation outcome with at least one `block` violation
determinism_notes: The test should inject a deterministic Nostr event and assert on created intents or published result events directly.
No browser or live relay is required.

tests.title: Deployment-intent helper publishes kind 5961 with service, environment, and artifact routing tags
tests.description: Verifies helper-level request shaping and correlated result handling for deployment intent creation.
preconditions: Public command helper module is loaded with mocked request publication and result-await helpers.
steps: Call `createDeploymentIntent(serviceId, environmentId, artifactId)`.
Assert `publishRequest` receives kind `5961` with the expected routing tags and content.
Assert `awaitResult` waits for the correlated `7961` result.
tests.expected_result: Deployment intent creation uses the signer-first public request/result contract with explicit routing tags.
data_requirements: Service id, environment id, and artifact id
determinism_notes: Request event id and result kinds are asserted from stubs rather than live traffic.

tests.title: Deployment approval helper publishes kind 5966 and awaits correlated public result
tests.description: Verifies helper-level request shaping for signer-first deployment approval.
preconditions: Public command helper module is loaded with mocked request publication and result-await helpers.
steps: Call `approveDeploymentIntent(intentId)`.
Assert `publishRequest` receives kind `5966` with `intent` and `decision=approve` tags.
Assert `awaitResult` waits for the configured approval result kinds.
tests.expected_result: Deployment approval uses the signer-first public request/result contract rather than a REST approval endpoint.
data_requirements: Pending deployment intent id
determinism_notes: The approval request is asserted entirely from mocked helper collaborators.

tests.title: Pending-approval browser flow publishes kind 5966 and converges to approved state
tests.description: Exercises the route-level approval flow from `/deployments/pending` through the public request/result path.
preconditions: Harness state contains a pending deployment intent by the time the pending page is opened.
steps: Open `/deployments/pending`.
Approve the first pending deployment.
Inspect the request-kind trace and resulting in-memory deployment state.
tests.expected_result: Approval emits kind `5966`, creates a completed run, and changes the intent approval status to `approved`.
data_requirements: One pending deployment intent in harness state by the time approval is attempted
determinism_notes: The harness mutates deterministic in-browser state and records request kinds locally.

tests.title: Deployment history page remains reactive to relay-backed intent and run projections
tests.description: Confirms `/deployments` reflects later projection updates from the shared relay-backed store instead of freezing a one-shot snapshot.
preconditions: The smoke journey has already created and approved a deployment intent so updated run state exists.
steps: Navigate to `/deployments` after deployment approval completes.
Assert the history table contains the target service and updated status from relay-backed state.
tests.expected_result: Deployment history reflects the later-approved/completed state from the shared control-plane store.
data_requirements: At least one deployment intent and one resulting deployment run after approval
determinism_notes: State changes are driven by harnessed projection updates rather than API refresh calls.

tests.title: Pending approvals page removes rows reactively after approval without refresh logic
tests.description: Confirms `/deployments/pending` derives pending rows from the shared relay-backed store and reacts when approval updates the intent projection.
preconditions: Harness state reaches a pending deployment intent before the page is loaded.
An approval action is available from the pending page.
steps: Open `/deployments/pending`.
Approve a pending deployment.
Assert the page renders `No pending approvals` after the relay-backed state updates.
tests.expected_result: Approved intents disappear from the pending list without REST refresh behavior.
data_requirements: At least one pending deployment intent that can transition to approved
determinism_notes: The page behavior is asserted after deterministic harness state mutation rather than server polling.

tests.title: One browser smoke journey proves the approved signer-first public service-to-deployment flow
tests.description: Acts as the vertical-slice browser proof for the approved journey: create service, observe immediate hydration, request policy preview, create deployment intent, approve deployment, and observe history/detail state.
preconditions: Public Nostr discovery and public state harnesses are installed.
Synthetic service projection emission is suppressed so immediate hydration must come from create-result handling.
steps: Create a service from `/services`.
Assert the created row is visible immediately.
Navigate to service detail, open deploy modal, and create a deployment intent after successful preview.
Approve the pending deployment and inspect `/deployments`, `/deployments/pending`, and deployment detail rendering.
tests.expected_result: A single browser journey proves the approved public-controlplane slice end to end without REST CRUD mocks.
data_requirements: One deployable existing service with artifact and environment
One newly created service from the browser flow
determinism_notes: The smoke test is deterministic because all relay traffic, request traces, and read-model projections are harnessed locally.
This test proves the main approved journey but does not settle the unresolved filtered-view service-list behavior or broader backend policy-enforcement question.

tests.title: Core public browser journey remains off encrypted request kind 5980
tests.description: Uses the recorded browser request trace to verify the selected core journey does not depend on the encrypted request kind reserved for another slice.
preconditions: The smoke journey has run through service create, preview, intent creation, and approval.
steps: Read the recorded request-kind trace from browser-local harness state.
Assert kind `5980` does not appear anywhere in the flow.
tests.expected_result: The approved core public slice remains isolated from the encrypted request surface.
data_requirements: Captured request-kind trace from the smoke journey
determinism_notes: The assertion is a pure inspection of the recorded harness trace.

implementation_notes: Matrix status is `ready`: all approved acceptance criteria are mapped to active coverage, including the 2026-05-06 follow-up decisions on backend `5961` enforcement and preserved `/services` list state.
CSTD-T-006 now proves preserved search, runtime filter, and pagination behavior after create, and immediate visibility only when the created service already matches the active view.
CSTD-T-011 now proves the in-flight preview-loading branch with a deterministic delayed-preview harness path that avoids sleep-based waiting.
CSTD-T-012 now proves canonical backend signer-first requests cannot bypass policy blocking by publishing kind `5961` directly.
The browser and backend coverage remain deterministic and relay-harnessed; no live external services are required.
